compute_object_detection_metrics: compute object detection metrics by evaluating detections as true positives or false positives from a single image
compute_tp_fp_for_single_class: compute true positive and false positive labels for boxes detected with the same class from the same image
remove_invalid_boxes: remove detected boxes with invalid coordinates where xmax is smaller than xmin or ymax is smaller than ymin
get_overlaps_and_scores_box_mode: get IoU overlaps and scores between detected boxes and ground truth boxes using box list operations
get_ith_class_arrays: get numpy arrays filtered by a specific class index for both detected and ground truth boxes and masks
